title: 36 Hours in Antigua
abstract: With pristine beaches and exhilarating views, this tiny island is one of those famously paradisiacal places that actually lives up to the hype.

title: 36 Hours in North Lake Tahoe
abstract: Flanked by epic mountain terrain that is home to 12 major ski resorts, Lake Tahoe is a year-round draw that sees some of its biggest crowds during ski season.

title: 36 Hours in Salvador, Brazil
abstract: Outside of Carnaval week each February, when the emphasis is decidedly on the present, this coastal city seems almost obsessed with its African past.
